# NexusFlow (CommercePilot)

> AI-Powered Commerce Marketing & Omnichannel Social Automation

NexusFlow connects online store product catalogs directly to AI-assisted marketing campaigns with human-in-the-loop review, automated publishing to official channels (Meta Instagram & LinkedIn), and verified closed-loop order attribution.

## Core Capabilities

- **Catalog Ingestion**: Synchronize product variants, pricing, media, and inventory from Shopify and custom store webhooks.
- **Grounded AI Studio**: Create marketing copy anchored to real catalog data with zero hallucinations.
- **Maker-Checker Governance**: Multi-tiered review flows requiring administrative approval before any scheduled release.
- **Omnichannel Publishing**: Automated release through official Meta Graph API v21.0 (Instagram Business) and LinkedIn Marketing API.
- **Attribution & Analytics**: Track order revenue mapped directly to specific social posts and campaigns using UTM parameters and signed order webhooks.

## Public Resources

- [Home Page](https://nexusflow.ai/): Overview of features, interactive studio, and customer governance.
- [Developer Portal](https://nexusflow.ai/developers): Integration guide for custom store webhooks, order attribution, and product ingest APIs.
- [App Registration](https://nexusflow.ai/register): Create a new merchant or agency workspace.

## Machine-Readable Endpoints

- OpenAPI Specification: /api/v1/docs-json
- Webhooks Endpoint: /api/v1/webhooks/orders
